subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu streaming card full-content updates cause severe latency regression on long replies

question: Should Feishu streaming cards add an explicit opt-in append/delta content mode, or should OpenClaw keep only the full-content CardKit contract and pursue another latency mitigation?
rationale: The reported performance fix conflicts with the full-content behavior that fixed truncation for other Feishu setups, and adding a config/default path is compatibility-sensitive under the repository policy.

options.title: Add Opt-In Lower-Payload Mode
options.body: Keep full-content updates as the default, add a documented Feishu-owned opt-in append/delta mode, and require live proof for both latency and final-content correctness.

options.title: Keep Full-Content Only
options.body: Reject append/delta mode and continue with coalescing or operational guidance such as disabling streaming cards for affected deployments.

options.title: Wait For More Live Logs
options.body: Pause the implementation direction until reporters provide redacted gateway timings and CardKit request counts for the current release and candidate fixes.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Lower-Payload Mode
recommendation.body: Keep full-content updates as the default, add a documented Feishu-owned opt-in append/delta mode, and require live proof for both latency and final-content correctness.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the declared Feishu plugin owner and this decision is about Feishu channel defaults and compatibility.
